narrative.overview: This design system rejects generic cyber-neon clichés in favor of an editorial engineering monograph inspired by precision industrial manuals and technical publishing.
keyCharacteristics: Warm carbon ink (#0C0B0A) in dark mode and archival drafting paper (#F6F3EC) in light mode.
Single high-contrast signal vermilion-copper accent (#E85D2A dark / #C84312 light).
Exposed 1px structural hairline rules and ledger rows instead of nested cards.
Expressive optical grotesque display typography (Bricolage Grotesque) paired with Manrope and JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Single Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Vermilion Copper is the only chromatic accent on the page; never combine it with secondary neon hues or multi-stop gradients.

rules.name: The Unassisted Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings (h1, h2, h3) never carry an eyebrow or kicker label above them; the heading's scale and wording carry the hierarchy directly.

rules.name: The Single Elevation Declaration Rule
rules.body: Page containers and project cards declare their boundary with a 1px border and never combine it with a diffuse drop shadow.

dos: Do lead the portfolio with verifiable production case studies (DIEX, AppFisio, MT Sublimação) immediately after the Hero.
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast (>= 4.5:1 for prose and metadata) in both dark and light themes.
Do pause WebGL rendering when off-screen and disable decorative motion when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active.
donts: Don't place eyebrows or kickers above h1, h2, or h3 headings.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text), neon cyan/violet glows, or HUD brackets.
Don't nest cards inside cards or use generic icon-plus-heading boxes for the About or Skills sections.
